top_signals.title: 10-year Treasury yield rises to highest since 2007
top_signals.summary: The benchmark 10-year Treasury yield climbed to its highest level since 2007 on Tuesday as a sell-off in U.S. government debt deepened ahead of the Federal Reserve's interest-rate decision.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Wade: AI Bosses ‘Genuinely Worried’
top_signals.summary: US President Donald Trump has waded into the AI safety debate raging between Silicon Valley and Washington. In a rapid-fire series of social media posts, Trump belittled a push led by Anthropic and OpenAI bosses to slow work on cutting-edge systems and dismissed the existential fears about AI as “a hoax.” Michael Wade, Professor of Strategy and Digital at the IMD business school in Switzerland spoke to Bloomberg’s Abeer Abu Omar on the need for AI guardrails. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
